plan.notes: Source: Northeast Community College official program sheet 'Agribusiness AAS' (https://northeast.edu/_documents/programs/agribusiness-aas.pdf), 'Required Program of Study for Associate of Applied Science Degree (2 years)'. Hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. Semester totals: Fall Y1 13, Spring Y1 19, Fall Y2 13, Spring Y2 15; plus an Internship Option (3-4 cr), for a degree total of 63-64. This seed models the internship as AGRI 1300 Cooperative Internship I (3 cr) in Summer, yielding 63. ENGL 1050 is placed in Fall Y1 as required to reach the catalog total of 63-64 (the PDF's column flow is ambiguous at the Fall/Spring boundary). The 4-cr science option (Spring Y1): AGRI 1010 & AGRI 1340 Animal Science & Lab, OR AGRI 1131 & AGRI 1132 Plant Science & Lab, OR AGRI 1030 & AGRI 1040 Soil Science & Lab, OR HORT 1010 Horticulture Science. Internship options per catalog: AGRI 1300 (3), AGRI 2020 Crops and Irrigation (summer, 3), AGRI 2040 Livestock Production Management (summer, 3), or AGRI 1115 & AGRI 2115 Global Opportunities in Agricultural Leadership (international travel, 4; AGRI 1115 prerequisite to AGRI 2115 must be taken in preceding semester) — work with advisor. Program Electives: see advisor. Per-course prerequisites are not listed on the program sheet; see https://northeast.edu/catalog. '*' marks gen-ed courses.
